contradictions_or_risks: Pincode values in the earlier seed are sometimes broad or likely copied from generic Patna results; they must be verified at canonical-address level before publication.
Several seed restaurant records have community-only evidence and should not display star ratings as objective scores.
A food corridor and a single restaurant are different entity types and should not be merged during deduplication.
The current UI contains placeholder reel links and a few hardcoded restaurant cards that are not yet fully source-backed; these should move to structured research data before launch.
